issues.detail: Threads TH2 (13 messages), TH3 (12 messages), and TH4 (14 messages) fall below the minimum required 15 messages per thread.
Several mandatory artifacts are missing from their respective threads: A3 and A4 are missing in TH2; A7 and T5 are missing in TH3; A7 and T4 are missing in TH4.
The text contains forbidden terms explicitly restricted by the prompt: 'label' (used in M19, M21, M25, M28, M29) and 'scenario' (used in M51, M54).
In thread_outcome.next_steps for TH2, TH3, and TH4, artifact IDs (A8, A2, A5) are used instead of valid task IDs from the backlog.
